verdict.rationale: Crossmint emits webhooks for wallet events (transfers, signer exports), payment and order lifecycle events, and user events. That lets developers build their own event-triggered automation in their own code. Its 'rules' are spending and transaction constraints (onchain transaction rules, policy engine, scoped delegations), which limit actions rather than trigger them. Agent Checkouts also have no webhooks in v1 and must be polled. missing for 10: a native rule engine that triggers actions on events, documented event-to-action configuration, webhook coverage for agent checkouts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
